card.name: Start of split drug-related words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a word split into parts, such as co in co-prescribing, Fl in Gout Flares, O in Opioids or Olanzapine, and Med in Medtronic. It fires in drug-label text, often after a heading or sentence start.

modes.label: Gout Flares
modes.description: The Fl that begins Flares right after the word Gout in dosing headings.

modes.label: co-prescribing
modes.description: The co that begins co-prescribing after the word Before.

modes.label: Sentence-initial drug names
modes.description: A single letter or short opening piece of an opioid or drug name at the start of a sentence.
modes.example: << O>>pioids are sought for nonmedical use

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted tokens are a mix of grade and level words and Chinese characters.
card.plain: It marks the first fragment of a longer drug or medical term that is about to be completed.
